headline: Vote on $2,356,182.48 in bond payments and a contract for Third Party Testing Services for the Dual Language School.
summary: The agenda includes a vote on a testing services contract and on $2,356,182.48 in outstanding bills. It also includes updates on Central Falls High School, the Raices Dual Language School, and other projects.
items: Owner's Project Manager and Ai3 Architects project updates: Central Falls High School update
Other project updates: abatement and demolition, retaining wall, track and field replacement
Minority and women business enterprise updates
Vote on recommendation to award contract for Bid #2026-0009: Third Party Testing Services Dual Language School Bid
School Building Committee Revolving Fund (potential vote): 26/27 Revolving Fund Subcommittee update
Vote on payments of outstanding bills: Bond Series 2025 Requisition #5, $2,356,182.48
